# Repository Topics

Set these topics on GitHub for Komi Store discoverability:

`android` `android-application` `apk` `connectivity` `expo` `mobile` `network` `open-source` `ping` `react-native`

To apply via GitHub CLI (requires repo admin):

```bash
gh api repos/Masterofowls/netprobe/topics -X PUT \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.mercy-preview+json" \
  -f names='["android","android-application","apk","connectivity","expo","mobile","network","open-source","ping","react-native"]'
```

Or set them manually under **Repository Settings → General → Topics**.
